description: This PHP class defines an API endpoint for managing employee timesheets within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for listing, creating, and updating timesheets, and integrates with various traits, models, and service classes to handle business logic, validation, and data persistence.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetAPI
classes.description: A PHP class implementing REST API endpoints for managing employee timesheets, including listing, creation, and updating timesheets with validation and transaction management.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list employee timesheets, with date validation and filtering.

methods.name: validateDateInputs
methods.description: Validates the date range parameters (fromDate and toDate) ensuring correct presence and logical order.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number from request parameters.

methods.name: getFromDateParam
methods.description: Retrieves and parses the 'fromDate' query parameter as a DateTime object.

methods.name: getToDateParam
methods.description: Retrieves and parses the 'toDate' query parameter as a DateTime object.

methods.name: getTimeSheets
methods.description: Fetches timesheets based on filter parameters, with counts, returning as collection result.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new timesheet for an employee for a specified date.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing timesheet with an action or comment, manages workflow states, logs actions, and handles transactions.

methods.name: setTimesheetActionLog
methods.description: Records an action taken on a timesheet along with comments and user info.
